name: game-cultural-localization
description: Game localization and culturalization plugin for AI coding agents. 15 languages, blind native ear critique, five voice archetypes, deterministic LQA gates.
suggestedPrompts: Build the context map of our game first, then localize the next locale with the 4-phase blind native-ear workflow (Phase 0-3)
Make a blind slice of our Pass 1 strings, run the native-ear critique, and rewrite every flagged entry
Run lqa_linter, ui_expansion_checker, and font_glyph_scanner on our localized string tables and fix all errors
Apply my accept and reject decisions and export the final texts into our game's own string tables
